title: The Clinical Establishments (Registration and Regulation) Act, 2010
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
sourceNote: Official India Code. The Act provides for registration and regulation of clinical establishments. India Code specifically records Uttar Pradesh as the location/state context for this Act entry.

title: The Pre-conception and Pre-natal Diagnostic Techniques (Prohibition of Sex Selection) Act, 1994
titleHi: गर्भधारण-पूर्व और प्रसव-पूर्व निदान-तकनीक (लिंग चयन प्रतिषेध) अधिनियम, 1994
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
sourceNote: Official India Code. The Act regulates genetic counselling centres, genetic laboratories, genetic clinics and prenatal diagnostic techniques and prohibits sex selection.

title: The Mental Healthcare Act, 2017
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
sourceNote: Official India Code. The Act provides the statutory framework for mental healthcare and protection of rights of persons with mental illness; it came into force on 29 May 2018.
